column1: # Tolbi, after Ash Jenna: Mia admits that Ash Jenna's taunts unsettled her.

column3: She wanted you to doubt\nyourself. Don't give her\nthat.{end_wait}
I won't. But she knew\nexactly where to strike.\nThat still hurts.{end_wait}
Then let us help you carry\nit. You don't have to\nprove anything to her.{end_wait}
I know. Next time she\ntries, I'll answer with\nwhat I do, not what she says.{end_wait}
